name: Music And The Devil
overview: Scripture reveals that music is a powerful means to glorify God, as seen in Psalms 150:1 and Romans 15:9, where singing and praise are directed toward the Lord. Believers are encouraged to engage in spiritual songs and make melody in their hearts to honor God (Ephesians 5:19). However, wisdom cautions against unwise or foolish songs that can lead the heart astray (Ecclesiastes 7:5), reminding us that not all influences, even among those close to Jesus, are pure (John 6:70). Therefore, Christians must guard their hearts and expressions, ensuring their music reflects godly truth rather than the devil’s deception.
